item.description:
First release. SplatShell is a native macOS app for viewing and editing 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, built around [SuperSplat](https://github.com/playcanvas/supersplat).
### Features - Open `.ply`, `.spz`, `.splat`, `.sog` and `.ssproj` files from File > Open or from Finder - Files are read from disk on demand, so scenes of tens of millions of splats open without a server or a browser tab - Very large scenes stay at display rate while the camera moves: the app draws SuperSplat's fast unsorted mode during motion and a sorted frame when the camera stops. The mode can be changed in SuperSplat's Preferences - Save and export through a standard save panel - Links inside SuperSplat open in your default browser - Automatic updates with Sparkle (Check for Updates… in the app menu)
### Known limitations - SuperSplat builds an exported file in memory before saving it, so an uncompressed export of a very large scene may not fit - Z-up scenes open lying on their side; set the rotation in SuperSplat's Transform panel
